If there is no sense experience, there is, according to the empiricists, no such thing as sense awareness at all—no intuitions in the representationalism of sense.

When we are aware of our representations it is only possible for us to compare those representations with the objects they represent, to distinguish between them by comparing their differences, if we already have representationalism and thereby have already compared objects with their representations.
Brentano rejects representationalism on the grounds that it cannot account for the possibility of error.
I was also deeply drawn to the work of the French realist painters: Pissarro, Manet, Degas, Monet and even the representationalist, Cézanne, for his skill as an draughtsman.
